data.gender_notes: Lennie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Leon, meaning 'lion'. The name Lennie is a diminutive form and is often given to boys. In Christian tradition, the lion is a symbol of courage, strength, and Christ. The name Lennie carries the meaning “Little Lion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lennie usually hope their child will grow to embody little lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Lennie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lennie total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the Old French name Leodegarde or Leodgarius, meaning 'People's warrior', which evolved into the modern English name Leonard, and subsequently the short form Lennie

data.cultural_impact: The name Lennie has a traditional and elegant ring to it. It is a well-known name with strong historical roots, representing the spirit and values of courage and strength, which have been celebrated throughout history. It is a name that evokes a sense of nobility and power.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Lennie is deeply spiritual, embodying the qualities of a lion, a symbol of Christ, who is often referred to as the 'Lion of Judah'. This name represents strength in the face of adversity and unwavering faith in God. It is a reminder of the courage and resilience that comes from having faith and trust in God during challenging times. The name Lennie is a powerful reminder of the strength and power of the Christian faith.
